lines.en: label yumifirsthall:
scene yumihall1
: Hey Yumi. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嗨，Yumi。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Oh, fuck no. Don't just walk up to me in the hall of the girls' dorm and act like you fuckin' own the place.
lines.zh: : 哦，操，别。别跑到女生宿舍的走廊上，装得跟这地方是你家似的。

lines.en: : All I did was say hi.
lines.zh: : 我就打了个招呼而已。

lines.en: : Which is a billion times more than you're allowed to say, douchenozzle.
lines.zh: : 那也比你被允许说的多出十亿倍了，蠢货。

lines.en: : There is absolutely no fucking way you are allowed over here. I don't believe it for even a second.
lines.zh: : 你绝对他妈的不该出现在这边。我一个字都不信。

lines.en: : Who's on the hit list today? Class prez? Fat-aba?
lines.zh: : 今天的暗杀名单上有谁？班长？肥-aba？

lines.en: : I was actually kind of hoping the two of us could hang out.
lines.zh: : 我其实还挺希望我们俩能一起待会儿的。

lines.en: scene yumihall2
: And I was actually kind of hoping I'd be able to stand in the hall of the building I fucking live in without worrying about some predator trying to sneak into my room.
lines.zh: : 我其实还挺希望我能站在我他妈住的那栋楼的走廊里，不用担心有哪个变态想溜进我的房间。

lines.en: : Get the fuck out of here. Now.
lines.zh: : 给我滚出去。现在。

lines.en: : I'm starting to think you don't want to be around me tonight.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你今晚不想跟我待在一起了。

lines.en: scene yumihall3
: Oh my fucking God. It's like talking to a brick wall- just the brick wall has a micropenis that gets hard every time it sees a pair of tits.
lines.zh: : 哦我操你的上帝。简直像在跟一堵砖墙说话——只不过这堵砖墙长了根小阴茎，每次看见一对奶子就会硬。

lines.en: : Your analogy game needs some work, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你的比喻水平还得练练啊，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumihall4
: My what? This that new teaching strategy I've been hearin' about?
lines.zh: : 我的什么？这就是我听说的那套新教学法？

lines.en: : You coming to our rooms to lecture us now since you're too busy sniffing our fucking gym clothes in the locker room during school hours.
lines.zh: : 你现在是忙得上课时间只能在更衣室里闻我们该死的运动服，所以改跑到我们房间里来训话了？

lines.en: : To my dismay and your fortune, I can assure you here and now that I don't have access to that room.
lines.zh: : 让你失望、也让你走运的是，我可以在此向你保证，我进不了那个房间。

lines.en: scene yumihall5
: Finally, some good fucking news.
lines.zh: : 总算有个他妈的好消息了。

lines.en: : So, what do you want to do? Go for a walk? Give me a tour of your dorm room?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想做点什么？去散个步？带我参观一下你的宿舍房间？

lines.en: scene yumihall6
: You mean right now? I don't know. Blowin' my brains out sounds pretty fuckin' appealing.
lines.zh: : 你是说现在？我可不知道。把自己脑袋轰开花听起来还挺他妈有吸引力的。

lines.en: : We're not hanging out tonight, are we?
lines.zh: : 我们今晚是没戏了，对吧？

lines.en: scene yumihall7
: Of fucking course not! Now get the hell out of here and never come back!
lines.zh: : 当——然——没——戏！现在立刻给我滚出去，永远别再回来！

lines.en: scene yumihall0
Yumi disappears into her dorm room, which I don't really blame her for since I definitely shouldn't be here.
lines.zh: Yumi 消失在她的宿舍房间里，我也不怪她，因为我确实不该在这儿。

lines.en: But hey, if no one is going to stop me, I'm going to keep on coming.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，既然没人拦我，我就会一直来。

lines.en: It's not like there's much else to do at night anyway.
lines.zh: 反正晚上也没别的事可做。

lines.en: For now, though, I guess I'll head back home.
lines.zh: 不过现在，我想我还是先回家吧。

lines.en: Yumi can only avoid me for so long...
lines.zh: Yumi 只能躲我这么久了……
